_meta.indication: KORSUVA is indicated for the treatment of moderate-to-severe pruritus associated with chronic kidney disease (CKD-aP) in adults undergoing hemodialysis (HD).

pivotal_trials.nct: Not stated in the reviewed documents
pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group trial; subjects randomized 1:1 to difelikefalin 0.5 mcg/kg or placebo with a 12-week double-blind treatment period.
pivotal_trials.population: Adults ≥18 years with ESRD on hemodialysis 3 times per week for at least 3 months with moderate-to-severe CKD-associated pruritus (US trial).
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of subjects achieving at least a 3-point improvement in WI-NRS score from baseline to Week 12 (protocol-specified primary endpoint).
pivotal_trials.result: ≥3-point improvement in WI-NRS at Week 12: 52% difelikefalin vs 31% placebo; difference 22% (95% CI 12%, 32%); odds ratio 2.7 (1.7, 4.3); p<0.001.

pivotal_trials.nct: Not stated in the reviewed documents
pivotal_trials.design: Randomized, multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel-group global trial; subjects randomized 1:1 to difelikefalin 0.5 mcg/kg or placebo with a 12-week double-blind treatment period.
pivotal_trials.population: Adults 18-85 years with ESRD on hemodialysis 3 times per week for at least 3 months with moderate-to-severe CKD-associated pruritus (global trial).
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Proportion of subjects achieving at least a 3-point improvement in WI-NRS score from baseline to Week 12 (protocol-specified primary endpoint).
pivotal_trials.result: ≥3-point improvement in WI-NRS at Week 12: 49% difelikefalin vs 38% placebo; difference 11% (95% CI 1%, 20%); odds ratio 1.6 (1.1, 2.4); p=0.020.

key_safety: Most common adverse reactions (≥2% and ≥1% higher than placebo): diarrhea (9.0% vs 5.7%), dizziness (6.8% vs 3.8%), nausea (6.6% vs 4.5%), gait disturbances including falls (6.6% vs 5.4%), hyperkalemia (4.7% vs 3.5%), headache (4.5% vs 2.6%), somnolence (4.2% vs 2.4%), and mental status change (3.3% vs 1.4%).
target_moa: Difelikefalin is a selective, full kappa opioid receptor (KOR) agonist with no agonist activity at mu or delta opioid receptors; KOR activation on peripheral sensory neurons and immune cells reduces itch. The relevance of KOR activation to therapeutic effectiveness is not known.
modality: Peptide (small synthetic peptide, kappa opioid receptor agonist)

advisory_committee.vote: No advisory committee was convened for this product.

basis.text: KORSUVA was granted breakthrough therapy designation on 21-JUNE-2017 for treatment of moderate-to-severe pruritus in hemodialysis patients.

summary.text: Difelikefalin (KORSUVA) was submitted as an NDA under section 505(b), received December 23, 2020; it received breakthrough therapy designation (June 21, 2017) and priority review by the Division of Dermatology and Dentistry, and was approved as a full (non-accelerated) approval based on two replicate Phase 3 trials.

citations.quote: Please refer to your new drug application (NDA) received December 23, 2020, and your amendments, submitted under section 505(b) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (FDCA) for Korsuva (difelikefalin) injection, 65 mcg/1.3mL.
KORSUVA was granted breakthrough therapy designation (BTD) on 21-JUNE-2017 by the Agency and was granted a priority review by the Division of Dermatology and Dentistry (DDD).
Difelikefalin demonstrated effectiveness in two adequate and well-controlled trials (i.e., CLIN3102 and CLIN3103) in subjects with moderate-to-severe CKD-aP undergoing HD.
